name: now-playing-controls
description: Controls for the song that's playing: slash commands (/next-song, /previous-song, /play-pause) and a row above the prompt with Previous, Play/pause and Next buttons, plus a /playback pane with the same buttons. Works with the Music app on a Mac, or whatever your Windows media controls show (YouTube Music in a browser, Spotify...). The slash commands work in the terminal; the row and the pane also show in the desktop app.
